# MSO official reading directory [繁體中文版 →](README.zh-Hant.md) **32 materials**, sorted by High → Medium → Low and recommended reading sequence within each level: 9 high, 19 medium, 4 low. Sort filenames in `EN/` or `TC/` and read in order. Filename format: `reading-order_priority_title (version)`, for example `03_High_…`. English and Chinese files with the same reading number refer to the same material. Also archived: **13 companion publications, 20 original files**, under `related/circular-number/`. They use the parent document number, without a second source-ID system. Priorities are study recommendations based on the official syllabus and document content, not published exam weights. High: first-pass essentials; Medium: second-pass reading or selected sections; Low: a final quick pass. Low does not mean unexaminable. Basis: Guidance Notes paragraphs 5.2-6.1. There are seven modules of five questions; passing requires at least three correct in every module and at least 25/35 overall. References include Cap. 615, the AML/CFT Guideline, Licensing Guide, other guidelines and circulars.
